caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or quilt design divided into sixteen square sections, each containing a large, central, yellow-orange pineapple shape with lattice-like crosshatch detailing. Surrounding each pineapple shape are brownish-green branches and leaves, with the leaves extending out from the central motif in various directions. The background is a pale, off-white or cream color, and a wavy border runs around the edge of the textile, also decorated with smaller plant motifs, including flowers and buds, in shades of red, orange, and yellow, with green accents. The composition is symmetrical and organized in a grid pattern with repeating elements, and the overall color palette is dominated by earthy tones: yellows, oranges, browns, greens, and subtle reds.
title: Pineapple Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
